name: mr-alps
description: Ranks mountain destinations worldwide on live conditions and your travel time.

interface.shortDescription: Where to ski or hike today
interface.longDescription:
MR. ALPS tells you where to go in the mountains today, tomorrow or this weekend. It ranks thousands of mountain destinations worldwide (ski resorts, hiking areas, villages) on the live weather forecast, snow depth, open lifts and slopes, and your door-to-door travel time by car or train, then gives the best places with a score out of 100, the reasons, the current conditions and a link to the live page with webcams.

Activities: skiing, snowboarding, freeride and off-piste, ski touring, ski mountaineering, cross-country skiing, snowshoeing, glacier skiing, snowpark, sledding, ice skating, ice climbing, snowkiting, après-ski, hiking, trail running, mountain biking, e-mountain bike, road cycling, rock climbing, bouldering, via ferrata, alpinism, canyoning, paragliding, rafting and whitewater, lakes and swimming, golf, thermal baths and spa, wildlife watching, national parks, mountain huts, scenic trains, culture, farmers markets and kids clubs (36 mountain activities).

It also finds places to stay near a destination with the lowest price per night seen for your dates. Read-only, no account, no login.
defaultPrompt: Where is the best skiing this weekend within 3 hours of Zurich?
How much snow does Zermatt have and how many lifts are open?
Find a hotel in Chamonix for 2 adults next weekend under 150 euros a night.

positive.prompt: Where is the best skiing this weekend within 3 hours of Zurich?
positive.expected_behavior: Up to 8 ski destinations reachable within 3 hours of Zurich for next weekend, each with a score out of 100, snow depth, open lifts or slopes when known, travel time and a link to the live page.

positive.prompt: How much snow does Zermatt have and how many lifts are open?
positive.expected_behavior: Current snow depth, open lifts and slopes (or closed status out of season), the weather forecast and the Zermatt page link.

positive.description: Places to stay under a budget
positive.prompt: Find a hotel in Chamonix for 2 adults next weekend under 150 euros a night.
positive.expected_behavior: A list of places to stay near Chamonix for next Friday to Sunday priced at or under 150 per night, cheapest first, with a link to compare and book on MR. ALPS.

positive.prompt: Best hiking tomorrow within 2 hours of Munich by train?
positive.expected_behavior: Hiking destinations reachable by train within 2 hours of Munich, ranked on tomorrow's forecast, with travel times and links.

positive.prompt: Which activities can MR. ALPS rank?
positive.expected_behavior: The 36 mountain activities with their names, such as skiing, ski touring, hiking, mountain biking, via ferrata and paragliding.

negative.prompt: Book the Hotel Alpina in Zermatt for me and pay with my credit card.

negative.description: City commute weather, not an outdoor destination
negative.prompt: Will it rain on my commute in central London tomorrow morning?
Write me a short poem about mountains in autumn.

publication.release_notes: First release: rank destinations, live conditions, places to stay, place search and activity list. Read-only, no login.

fr-FR.subtitle: Où skier ou randonner
fr-FR.description: MR. ALPS vous dit où aller en montagne aujourd'hui, demain ou ce week-end : il classe des milliers de destinations dans le monde selon la météo, la neige, les remontées ouvertes et votre temps de trajet, pour 36 activités (ski, ski de randonnée, randonnée, VTT, escalade, via ferrata, parapente...). Il trouve aussi où dormir avec le prix par nuit.

de-DE.subtitle: Wo heute Ski oder Wandern
de-DE.description: MR. ALPS sagt dir, wohin es heute, morgen oder am Wochenende in die Berge geht: Tausende Bergziele weltweit, gerankt nach Wetter, Schnee, offenen Liften und deiner Reisezeit, für 36 Aktivitäten (Ski, Skitouren, Wandern, Mountainbike, Klettern, Klettersteig, Gleitschirm...). Dazu Unterkünfte mit Preis pro Nacht.

it-IT.subtitle: Dove sciare o camminare
it-IT.description: MR. ALPS ti dice dove andare in montagna oggi, domani o nel weekend: classifica migliaia di destinazioni nel mondo in base a meteo, neve, impianti aperti e tempo di viaggio, per 36 attività (sci, scialpinismo, escursionismo, mountain bike, arrampicata, via ferrata, parapendio...). Trova anche dove dormire con il prezzo a notte.

es-ES.subtitle: Dónde esquiar o caminar
es-ES.description: MR. ALPS te dice adónde ir a la montaña hoy, mañana o este fin de semana: clasifica miles de destinos en todo el mundo según el tiempo, la nieve, los remontes abiertos y tu tiempo de viaje, para 36 actividades (esquí, esquí de travesía, senderismo, bici de montaña, escalada, vía ferrata, parapente...). También encuentra alojamiento con precio por noche.
